title: The Captions section says every button and colour whole
goal: In the Captions section the button that writes the captions again reads "Write Ag..." at the panel's normal width, and after picking the Lower third look the Background row shows a code (#000000B3) instead of a colour name. Both should read as words a person understands.
notes: Found by every-panel-follows-the-design-system (2026-09-24). Reproduce: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/captions-write-themselves-walk.json --no-build; 2-the-captions-wrote-themselves-sc.png shows the Generate button as "Write Ag..." beside "10 captions"; 6-lower-third-at-the-top-sc.png shows Background as "#000000B3". CaptionsInspector.generate puts a borderedProminent button with label "Write Again" and the count in a 148pt column; colourRow names a value only when it is one of Self.plates, and the Lower third preset (CaptionLook.Preset) sets a plate that is not in that list. In the narrowest dock the button reads "W...".
acceptance: At the dock's default width the Generate row shows its button label whole, next to the caption count
After picking Lower third, Background reads a colour name from its own list, not a hex code
captions-panel-keeps-its-margins-walk checks both readings and passes at the default and the narrowest dock
The Easing menu in the timeline bar reads its whole name at the default window size

No label in the video chrome (timeline bar, track headers, panel sections, Library tiles, transition rows) is cut off with an ellipsis at the default window size, checked by one walk step that reads them all
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
